carburization.title: Post-deposition gaseous carburization screening
model_notes: Fickian diffusion, finite slab with both sides carburized, Fourier superposition for Fo>0.2
D = D0 exp(-Q/RT) with γ-Fe D0=2.3e-5 m2/s Q=148 kJ/mol, α-Fe D0=6.2e-7 Q=80 kJ/mol (screening means)
Hardness: Maynier HV=127+949C (C<0.8 wt%) saturating at 900 HV, quench-rate knockdown for bainite
Tempering optional via Hollomon-Jaffe parameter
Does NOT model carbide precipitation, retained austenite, or decarburization on quench
Energy is only heating, not soak or atmosphere — screening only

carbon_potential.title: Carbon potential screening — gas carburizing atmosphere

example_summary_930C.note: Screening carbon potential: Boudouard ΔG=170700-174.5T J/mol, CH4 cracking 90000-109T J/mol. C_wt from a_C via empirical a(C)= (C/1.1)*exp(0.9(C-1.1)) normalized at 900°C a=1→1.1wt%. Acm linear 0.76% at 727°C to 2.14% at 1147°C. Calibrate with O2 probe/milliprob foil.

model_notes: Boudouard: ΔG°=170700-174.5T J/mol, K=exp(-ΔG/RT), aC=K*pCO^2/pCO2
CH4 cracking: ΔG°=90000-109T J/mol, aC=K*pCH4/pH2^2
O2 from CO+0.5O2→CO2 ΔG°=-282800+86.8T J/mol, pO2=(pCO2/(pCO*K))^2
Dew point → pH2O via Magnus, then via WGS K to pCO2 then aC
C wt from aC via empirical a(C)= (C/1.1)*exp(0.9(C-1.1)) at 900°C a=1→1.1wt%
Acm linear 0.76% at 727°C to 2.14% at 1147°C
Calibrate with O2 probe and foil measurements; not full CALPHAD

tempering.title: Tempering & retained austenite screening
model_notes: Ms via Andrews: Ms=539-423C-30.4Mn-17.7Ni-12.1Cr-7.5Mo-7.5Si+10Co (°C)
RA via Koistinen-Marburger: f_RA=exp(-0.011*(Ms-Tq)), f_M=1-f_RA
Tempering P = T_K*(19.5+log10(t_s)), HV_t = HV_q*exp(-k*(P-8000)), k=0.00018 screening
Case hardness from carburization profile + RA per local C + tempering
Recommended T for target HV via bisection inverse
Target HV 700->~200C, 600->~350C, 500->~450C, 400->~550C typical low-alloy
Calibrate with XRD RA, hardness traverses, dilatometry

D_fit.note: Fitted D=9.45e-14 m2/s vs theory 8.64e-12 at 930C, Cs fit 1.14 wt% (phase austenite)

Conservative (Base).description: Near-term alkaline electrowinning with conventional electrode materials and moderate current density. Represents a cautious estimate based on established electroplating technology scaled to bulk production.
Conservative (Base).references: Standard alkaline electroplating literature; Yuan & Haarberg (2009)

Optimized Alkaline.description: High-efficiency alkaline route using concentrated NaOH with nanoporous Fe₂O₃ intermediates and rotating cathode for enhanced mass transport. Based on Yuan et al. (2009) and Kempler et al. (2025) demonstrating >90% current efficiency with unique twin-crystal morphology.
Optimized Alkaline.references: Yuan & Haarberg (2009); Kempler et al. (2025) ACS Nano

AWARE Acidic.description: Acidic electro-Winning in Anion-Rich Electrolytes using concentrated LiCl-based systems. Achieves near-unity Coulombic efficiency by thermodynamically suppressing HER through high chloride activity and stabilizing Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ in solution. Zero-waste operation with high impurity tolerance.

Future Target.description: Aspirational scenario assuming R&D breakthroughs in catalyst design, membrane technology, and process integration. Combines high current density with low cell voltage through advanced electrode architectures (nanostructured cathodes, ultra-thin separators) and AI-optimized pulse-reverse deposition protocols.
Future Target.references: Projected; based on extrapolation of current trends
